cost_method: At native entry/exit and +100/+1000ms, strictly prior best ask for buying and bid for selling; reject quote age>1second, nonpositive size or locked/crossed book. One contract. Displayed touch is a counterfactual, not guaranteed fill. Reprice existing fixed trades only; no alternate stop/time path simulation.
limitations: Native slippage2/4 yielded identical fills; fees5/10 are external; added2/4ticks perfill arithmetic. Touch repricing replaces native prices and must not also subtract full spread. Missing/ambiguous timestamps stay unavailable. No retuning.
quality: Same frozen L1 quality and header consistency gates;390 RTH minutes required
restart: If Oct6 is complete, preregister2 native historical-extension runs before any outcomes; otherwise document missing coverage and future fixed-version plan.
